rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.0025, tv_iterations=1200, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-12 CONVERGENCE at the peak config. Both late-step levers destabilize: iter-10 lr 0.01->0.02 -> 0.29146, iter-11 decay 0.01->0.001 -> 0.16989. So GD lr=0.01, decay=0.01 is the stable schedule; revert both. Earlier GD logs show the TV term still descending at iter-1000 (under-converged) but larger steps oscillate. The stable way to converge further is MORE iterations at the safe schedule. ONE knob: tv_iterations 1000->1200 (keep gd, lambda=2.5e-3, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, fbp). HYPOTHESIS: 200 more stable GD iters converge TV further so hr rises past 0.36286; if saturated, GD/TV has converged and 0.36286 is the plateau. Budget: iter-8 ~950s at 1000 iters -> ~1140s at 1200, still <1200s wall (watch).
